def mincover(I,O,S,H,W):
    plc=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if all((i+a,j+b) in O for a,b in S)]
    need=O-I
    # greedy set cover
    import itertools
    uncovered=set(need); chosen=[]
    while uncovered:
        best=max(plc,key=lambda p: len({(p[0]+a,p[1]+b) for a,b in S}&uncovered))
        chosen.append(best)
        uncovered-={(best[0]+a,best[1]+b) for a,b in S}
        if len(chosen)>10: break
    return chosen,uncovered
